```{r}
library(readr)
```

```{r}
df_history <- read_csv("../data/semi_processed/steamidx_player_history.csv")
```

```{r}
str(df_history)
```

```{r}
# Convert to dates
df_history$Date <- as.Date(
  df_history$observed_at,
  format = "%Y-%m-%d"
)

head(df_history)

```

```{r}
# Group observation dates by AppID
dates_by_game <- split(
  df_history$Date,
  df_history$app_id
)

# Sort and remove duplicate
dates_by_game <- lapply(dates_by_game, function(x) {
  sort(unique(x))
})
```

```{r}
# Check whether each game has gaps between observation dates
has_gap <- sapply(dates_by_game, function(x) {
  any(diff(x) > 1)
})

# Count games with non-consecutive observation dates
sum(has_gap)

# Count games with consecutive observation dates
sum(!has_gap)

# Identify AppIDs with non-consecutive observation dates
#gap_ids <- names(has_gap[has_gap])

```

```{r}
# summary of the observation period for each game
period_summary <- data.frame(
  app_id = names(dates_by_game),

  # First observation date
  StartDate = as.Date(sapply(dates_by_game, min),
                      origin = "1970-01-01"),

  # Last observation date
  EndDate = as.Date(sapply(dates_by_game, max),
                    origin = "1970-01-01"),

  # Number of unique observed dates
  ObservedDays = lengths(dates_by_game)
)

# Calculate the total number of days between the first
# and last observation dates, inclusive
period_summary$TotalDays <- as.integer(
  period_summary$EndDate - period_summary$StartDate
) + 1

# Calculate the number of missing days within each observation period
period_summary$MissingDays <- 
  period_summary$TotalDays - period_summary$ObservedDays

# Check whether the observation period is continuous
period_summary$Continuous <- period_summary$MissingDays == 0

View(period_summary)
```


```{r}
mean(period_summary$ObservedDays)
```

```{r}
summary(period_summary$MissingDays)
```

```{r}
end_date <- as.Date("2026-11-21")

# end time
end_dates <- sapply(dates_by_game, function(x) {
  as.character(max(x))
})

table(end_dates)

# game with diff end time
sum(end_dates != as.character(end_date))

# Retain only games whose last observation date matches the common end date
selected_games <- dates_by_game[
  end_dates == as.character(end_date)
]
```

```{r}
period_result <- data.frame()

for (days in 1:76) {

  start_date <- end_date - (days - 1)

  expected_dates <- seq(
    start_date, end_date, by = "day"
  )

  # games observed before
  eligible_games <- Filter(function(x) {
    min(x) <= start_date
  }, selected_games)

  # missing days per game
  missing_days <- sapply(eligible_games, function(x) {
    sum(!expected_dates %in% x)
  })

  period_result <- rbind(
    period_result,
    data.frame(
      Days = days,
      StartDate = start_date,
      EndDate = end_date,
      Games = length(eligible_games),
      CompleteGames = sum(missing_days == 0),
      IncompleteGames = sum(missing_days > 0),
      MissingDays = sum(missing_days)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot(
  period_result$Days,
  period_result$CompleteGames,
  type = "l",
  xlab = "Observation Period (Days)",
  ylab = "Number of Games",
  main = "Complete Games by Observation Period"
)

plot(
  period_result$Days,
  period_result$MissingDays,
  type = "l",
  xlab = "Observation Period (Days)",
  ylab = "Missing Days",
  main = "Missing Days by Observation Period"
)
```
